title: 2D nanobeam cavity, quarter model with two mirror planes (FDFD eigenfrequency)
description:
The nanobeam_cavity_fdfd cavity (500 nm strip, eps_eff 8.12, 2 x 12 air holes, a = 350 nm, r = 0.28 a, defect gap L_def between the innermost holes) cut to one quarter by two antisymmetric mirror planes on the domain edges (E mirror-odd, PEC planes: tangential E = 0, H_z even): x_lo is the cavity centre (E_y = 0 there, H_z at its peak), y_lo the beam axis (E_x = 0). That is the parity of the cavity mode (~1435 nm, Q in the thousands): with a symmetric (PMC) plane at the centre the run found no cavity mode, with the antisymmetric one it did. The holes are drawn about the edges (the innermost centred at x = L_def / 2, all on y = 0, halved by the beam-axis plane). Only modes of the cavity's parity exist here, so the band-edge and leaky modes of the other three parities no longer crowd the target, and the model has about a quarter of the unknowns; the cavity lambda and Q should equal the full model's to the mesh differences (the auto mesh grades each model on its own window).
Same settings as nanobeam_cavity_fdfd: em_fdfd_hz eigenfrequency study at lambda_target = 2 a n_B (n_B = 2.05: ~1435 nm, on the cavity mode), 6 resonances, subpixel smoothing, auto mesh with 40 points per wavelength in each material, CPML on x_hi and y_hi, GPU cuDSS eigen solver node (gpu backend, nvmath-python; 'Host SuperLU' without a GPU).
Derived values / Sweep tab: lambda_1, Q_1, Q_max and pml_1 vs L_def_nm, the defect gap in nm (1.3-2.1 a = 455-735 nm, 20 points; model parameters carry no unit, so a swept length in m would show as x 1e-9).
Field tab: |H_z| and Re H_z of each resonance over the quarter (Snapshot slider).

parameters.name: w_beam
parameters.description: beam width (the model holds the upper half)

parameters.name: eps_beam
parameters.description: beam permittivity (effective index 2.85 of a 220 nm silicon slab, TE)

parameters.name: L_def_nm
parameters.description: defect gap in nm (swept: a number, so the Sweep tab axis reads nm)

parameters.name: L_def
parameters.description: centre-to-centre spacing of the two innermost holes (the defect)

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: air beside the beam, and beam beyond the outermost hole + a, before the PML (the beam runs into the x PML)

parameters.name: L_mirror
parameters.description: innermost to outermost hole centre of one mirror (12 holes)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length: cavity centre (x = 0) to the x PML

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height: beam axis (y = 0) to the y PML

parameters.name: n_bragg
parameters.description: Bloch index at the stop band, from a first run: cavity mode at ~1435 nm (sets the target only)

parameters.name: lambda_target
parameters.description: eigenfrequency target (1435 nm, on the cavity mode)
